formatting.fileFormat: Word document. "For submission and review, please submit the manuscript as a Word document. Do not submit your manuscript in PDF format." Figures as separate files (1 file per figure); tables at the end of the manuscript file, not as images or separate files. Recommended file sizes: individual files no more than 500 kB and not exceeding 1 MB; total for all files not exceeding 5 MB (not including video).
formatting.font: 10-, 11-, or 12-point font size ("Use 10-, 11-, or 12-point font size, double-space text, and leave right margins unjustified (ragged).")
formatting.margins: Right margins unjustified (ragged); no numeric margin widths are stated
formatting.pageNumbers: "Start each of these sections on a new page, numbered consecutively, beginning with the title page."
formatting.referenceStyle: AMA Manual of Style (11th edition). "Number references in the order they appear in the text; do not alphabetize." "In text, tables, and legends, identify references with superscript arabic numerals." "List all authors and/or editors up to 6; if more than 6, list the first 3 followed by 'et al.'" Journal references include the issue number in parentheses after the volume number; abbreviate journal names per PubMed. "AI, LLM, and chatbots should not be used to generate or format references."
formatting.coverLetter: Required: "Include a cover letter and complete contact information for the corresponding author" (tag: Include: All Journals / Exclude: JNO) — affiliation, mailing address, email, telephone — and state whether related papers from the same study have been published, posted, or submitted elsewhere.
formatting.supplement: Section is titled "Supplement" (tag: Include: JNO and JHF). "Supplemental material should be submitted in a single Word document with pages numbered consecutively." "The first page of the supplemental document should list the number and title of each element included in the document." Items are cited in the text and "numbered in order of citation in the text (eg, eTable 1, eTable 2, eFigure 1, eFigure 2, eMethods)". "Supplemental text should be set in Times New Roman font, 10 point in size, and single-spaced." (main heading 12 pt bold, subheadings 10 pt bold). "The text and data in supplemental tables should be Arial font, 10 point in size, and single-spaced." (titles Arial 12 pt bold; footnotes 8 pt). Supplemental figure titles Arial 12 pt bold, legends 8 pt; graphs exported as vector files; photographs .jpg or .tif at 300 dpi, 3-5 inches wide. Supplement references in a separate numbered reference section. Material "will not be edited or formatted". Trial protocols with complete statistical analysis plans "should be cited in the Methods section" and "submitted as supplemental content". The Data Sharing Statement is published "in an online supplement linked to the published article". Excel files may be submitted as eTables (one workbook with a contents tab). Large datasets belong in public repositories.
formatting.titlePage: First page of the manuscript file. "It should include a manuscript title; the full names, highest academic degrees, and affiliations of all authors" (if an author's affiliation changed since the work was done, list the new affiliation too); "name and complete contact information for corresponding author"; "manuscript word count (not including title, abstract, acknowledgment, references, tables, and figure legends)".

keyPoints.rules: "In the manuscript, include a separate section called 'Key Points' before the Abstract." (tag: Include: Specialty Journals, JNO, JHF). "Limit this section to 75-100 words or less." "(required only for research and review manuscripts)". Question: "Focused question based on the study hypothesis or goal/purpose. Limit to 1 sentence." Findings: "Results of the study/review. Include the design" (eg, clinical trial, cohort study), primary outcomes with basic numbers and whether results are significant, without test statistics; "Can include 1 to 2 sentences." Meaning: "Key conclusion and implication based on the primary finding(s). Limit to 1 sentence." Original Investigation: "A list of 3 Key Points is required". Research Letters: no Key Points. NOTE: the 75-100 word sentence sits in shared text after a JAMA-tagged line whose comment says the tag covers only that one line; one fetch read it as JAMA-only, so treat the exact limit with mild caution.

journalNotes: The instructions page is a template shared across JAMA Network journals with visible 'Include:/Exclude:' tags (JHF = JAMA Health Forum). Several blocks carry conflicting tags (Brief Report, Meta-analysis, Systematic Review, Viewpoint DER-only block); conflicts are flagged in the relevant article-type notes.

Cover letter is required ("Include a cover letter and complete contact information for the corresponding author"; tag Include: All Journals / Exclude: JNO), including whether related papers from the same study were published, posted, or submitted elsewhere.

Supplement: the section is titled "Supplement" (tag Include: JNO and JHF); single Word document, supplemental text in Times New Roman 10 pt single-spaced, supplemental tables in Arial 10 pt; items named eTable/eFigure/eMethods in citation order. Trial protocols are submitted as supplemental content; the Data Sharing Statement is published in an online supplement linked to the article.

JAMA Forum is not described on the instructions page (it appears only as 'JAMA Forum Archive' in site navigation). Editorials and Comment & Response are not described either; Invited Commentaries are mentioned only in the abstract exemption sentence.

Article types tagged as NOT for JHF: Letters to the Editor / Letter in Reply / Correspondence ("Include: All Journals except JNO and JHF"), Narrative Review, Perspective, Clinical Challenge and other challenge types, Images, Humanities, Teachable Moment, Inside Story, Observation, Clinical Practice Guidelines (JNO-only tag).

Presubmission inquiries are required for Special Communications and Consensus Statements ("This article type requires a presubmission inquiry to" / "All submissions require a presubmission inquiry to" the editorial office email).
"If accepted for publication, all articles are published online only." (tag: Include: JNO and JHF).

Open access: accepted research articles are open access on publication following payment of article processing charges; "Payment of $4000 and grant of a Publication License to the journal." (CC-BY-NC-ND; CC-BY limited to funders that require it). Waivers and discounts are available for eligible authors from Hinari Core Offer countries.

Peer review: single-anonymized; "typically 2 peer reviewers per manuscript with additional review by a statistical editor" (tag: Include: JHF). "Submitted manuscripts may be reviewed with software to detect plagiarism and inappropriate duplication." (tag includes JHF).
Postpublication Online Commenting (tag: Include: JNO and JHF): comments "should not exceed 600 words, including references."

"For all reports of research, authors are required to provide a Data Sharing Statement"; "Authors of research articles should follow the EQUATOR Reporting Guidelines." (tag: Include: SJs, JNO, and JHF).

The referral sentence (manuscripts not accepted being referred to a JAMA Network specialty journal or JAMA Network Open) is tagged 'Include: All journals except JNO and JHF'; it does not apply to JHF.

Titles: "Please limit the length of titles to 100 characters (including spaces) for reports of research and other major articles" and "60 characters (including spaces) for shorter article types such as opinion articles" and for subtitles; avoid declarative titles, titles stating result direction, and questions.

Figures: "Do not submit figures with more than 4 panels unless otherwise justified."; "In general each figure should be no larger than 1 MB."; minimum resolution ≥350 ppi (photographs/illustrations) and ≥600 ppi (line drawings); no pie charts, 3-D graphs, or stacked bar charts. Tables single-spaced in 10- or 12-point font with titles preferably no longer than 10 to 15 words.

AI: content created by AI/LLMs is discouraged unless part of the formal research design; any AI use must be reported in the Acknowledgment section; AI may not generate or format references; AI may not draft Opinion manuscripts, Letters, or Online Comments; AI-created or -manipulated clinical images are not permitted; "Nonhuman artificial intelligence, language models, machine learning, or similar technologies do not qualify for authorship."

Conflicts of interest and funding statements are required in the Acknowledgment section for all journals; authors without conflicts must state so. No more than 2 co-corresponding authors are permitted.
unread: All text was fetched in three chunks (offsets 0, 100000, 200000; the page is 200,147 characters and the final chunk held only footer text). However, the fetch tool summarizes the page with a small model and caps quotations at ~125 characters, so the page could not be read verbatim; values were cross-checked across multiple targeted fetches, and residual tag ambiguities (notably Brief Report and Meta-analysis) are noted per article type.
